requirement: The system shall allow users to register accounts with basic personal information and log in using account credentials; allow logged-in regular users to submit scholar certification information for administrator approval before receiving scholar permissions; allow scholars to edit their nickname, email address, and institutional affiliation; and display scholars' basic information, academic achievements, and cooperation networks.

The system shall retrieve literature across dimensions including keywords, disciplines, institutions, and authors; support natural-language and multi-turn conversational search using semantic error correction and cross-language term mapping, with multilingual results and translation support for Chinese, English, Japanese, and German literature; and allow users to filter results and sort them by relevance, citation count, and publication time.

The system shall support academic interaction through user comments on achievement pages that are publicly displayed after review and approval, questions from regular users and scholars to authors on literature detail pages, point-to-point private messaging after both participants pass two-way identity verification, following scholars, collaborative annotations, and sharing analysis reports.

The system shall manage academic achievements through dynamically constructed multi-level academic field classifications, scholar claims with verification of the association between claimant identity and achievement and binding of confirmed achievements to scholars, and claim appeals handled through system preliminary review, expert review, and management final review.

The system shall support applications to join or create research institutions, review by institutional or system administrators, and dynamic management of a three-level university, institute, and laboratory relationship tree.

The system shall periodically collect scholar profiles and literature from public databases through web crawlers and APIs, standardize, deduplicate, and structure the collected data, synchronize incremental academic achievement updates daily, and periodically generate research hotspot analysis reports and influence profiles from the collected academic data.

The system shall use user profiles to personalize content recommendations and literature presentation and recommend promising researchers from other disciplines when repeated same-field searches trigger diversity rules.

The system shall protect access to and disclosure of academic data by requiring institutional administrator authorization to view unpublished achievements, delaying disclosure of sensitive information such as influence rankings for three months, protecting private messaging through an encrypted communication channel, and protecting sensitive user and academic achievement data using AES-256 encryption.

The system shall provide persistent hybrid storage for relational and unstructured data, including literature entries and user behavior logs, with daily full backups and hourly incremental backups retained for 30 days.
The system shall provide academic misconduct detection mechanisms including draft plagiarism checking and blacklist filtering.

The system shall separate user-facing business logic in an application layer, shared academic services in a support layer called by the application layer, and underlying computing, data acquisition, and persistence in an infrastructure layer.
